entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Sarah Miller. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just so hard to use. The menu is confusing and I can never find the setting I'm looking for. I guess I just expected more for the price.
I see. And have you had a chance to look through the user manual? Sometimes it can help clarify the interface.
I skimmed the user manual. It didn't help. I just want to send it back.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear it's not working out for you. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. I see it was delivered 21 days ago.
Okay, I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and start that return process for you right now.
Okay. Whatever. Just get it done.

Absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email inbox within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Great. So I get my money back?
Yes, once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good day.
